content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-197. - I.R.C. Section R908.7, Step and counter flashing.
content.summary:
Section R908.7. Step and counter flashing,
is added to read as follows:
"R908.7.
Step and counter flashing.
Flashing shall be installed in accordance with Section R905."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
